I was initially hesitant about purchasing a Lava Pro Blaze 5G for my son, but their commitment to customer satisfaction, including home service options, swayed my decision

Unfortunately, my son accidentally damaged the charging port. After unsuccessful attempts at local repair, I opted for Lava's home pickup service. The technician arrived promptly, assessed the damage, and provided a transparent quote for the out-of-warranty repair. The turn-around time was impressively quick, and the technician even offered home delivery.

I was impressed with the professionalism and efficiency of Mobile Master, an authorized service partner. The service center was well-organized, and the staff were knowledgeable and helpful.

I highly recommend Mobile Master for reliable and efficient phone repair service

featured_reviews.name: Abhi
featured_reviews.review_text: "I visited a service center. While there to get my mobile phone repaired, I noticed that they also repair laptops. I handed over my brand-new laptop—which was out of warranty—specifically to have it formatted. However, without seeking my permission, they opened up my laptop—even though I had given it to them solely for the /formatting. They opened my device without my consent. When I returned to collect the laptop, I discovered that its screws were loose. When I requested to view the CCTV footage to verify that why they had not opened my device, they claimed that their CCTV system was down. I then asked them to summon the technician who had worked on the laptop; they replied that he had gone to offer his namaj prayers and would not be returning. Please, I urge you not to entrust any of your devices to this place for repair. As I was about to leave town, I was unable to pursue the matter further or argue with them. I strongly advise you to exercise extreme caution if you choose to hand over any item to them for repair."
